items.title: Speedrunlab/reverse-engineer-anything-self-learning-loop — Agent skill: examine a product you're authorised to rebuild, build your own, then test against the original an
items.summary: Reverse Engineer Anything with a Self-Learning Loop: examine a product you are authorised to rebuild, build your own version, and keep improving it until every must-have on a written checklist passes. Free and open source · MIT Licence · Built by Speedrun AI Labs, Sydney, Australia Inspired by REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) by @morluto: github.com/morluto/rea. Give an agent a shipped product and ask for an equivalent, and you get something that is "80% there". It looks right, the obvious paths work, and then it stops, because nobody wrote down what 100% means and nothing measures the build against the original. This skill is that last 20%, as a method.
